description: SQL-AGG-NUMERIC, deciding variants: large offset, spread and magnitude. AgV groups: g1 1e9 + (4, 7, 13, 16) (exact Var 30), g2 1e15 + (1, 2, 3) (Var 1), g3 1e8 + (0.1, 0.2, 0.3), g4 1e16 + (0, 2, 4) (Var 4), g5 1e150 * (1, 2, 3), g7 1e154 * (1, 2, 3) (squares overflow). Asks Var, VarP, StDev, StDevP, Avg and Sum for every group at once and for g5 and g7 alone, so an overflow in a group does not hide the others; the exact two-pass values are recomputed offline. Follow-up probe (status F) for SQL-AGG-NUMERIC, SQL-AGG-SINGLE; runs on a read-only open of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
